Top başının üstünde. Uzun ve orta hızda: The shuttle is overhead. Swipe up long at medium speed: send it high so it lands in the back band. A high clear buys you time to get back to base.
Baş üstünde hızlı kaydır ama smaç kadar: Swipe fast overhead, but not smash fast (between Medium and Fast on the speed band): the shuttle travels low and quick to the back. A low clear makes your opponent run back.
Topun üstünden yavaş ve kısa, düz yukarı: Swipe slow, short and straight up over the shuttle: it drops down the line, tight to the net, in the lit band.

Hızlı ve düz yukarı kaydır: smaç aynı çi: Swipe fast and straight up: the smash goes down the line, parallel to the sideline.
Hızlı kaydır ve parmağını karşı tarafa e: Swipe fast and angle your finger to the other side: the smash crosses the court.
The coach lifts high to mid-court. Get under the shuttle and swipe fast: a smash from mid-court comes down steep, into your opponent's front and middle court.
Top filenin dibine düşüyor. Bandın altın: The shuttle is dropping at the net. Push slow and short below the tape: it skims over and falls straight down.
Top file dibinde. Yavaş kaydır ve parmağ: The shuttle is at the net. Swipe slow and angle your finger across: it travels along the net to the far corner.
Top file dibinde, bandın altında. Orta h: The shuttle is at the net, below the tape. Swipe up at medium speed: it rises and lands on your opponent's baseline. An underarm clear counts as a lift too.
Kısa servis duruşundan kısa ve sert bir: From the short-serve stance, a short, sharp flick: the shuttle goes over your opponent's head to the back of the service box.
Top göğüs hizasında geliyor. Hızlı ve dü: The shuttle comes at chest height. Swipe fast and flat: it crosses low over the net into the mid-to-back court.
Antrenör smaç atıyor. Parmağını aşağı çe: The coach is smashing. Pull your finger down: the racket meets the shuttle softly and it drops in front of the net.
Top ön sahana göğüs hizasında geliyor. O: The shuttle comes to your front court at chest height. Swipe at medium speed (Medium on the speed band): the racket pushes it flat and soft into your opponent's mid-court.
Antrenör her topu başka yere atıyor. Her: The coach feeds every shuttle somewhere new. Pick a different shot each time and land it in: the same shot twice in a row does not count.

U sınıfı: 5U 75–79 g, 4U 80–84 g, 3U 85–: U class: 5U 75–79 g, 4U 80–84 g, 3U 85–89 g. A light racket swings fast; a heavy one drives the shuttle harder and tires the arm more.
Distance from the butt of the handle to the centre of mass. Head-heavy: strong smashes and clears, slower drives and net play. Head-light: fast defence and net play, softer smashes.
Esnek şaft yavaş kolda da güç verir ve a: A flexible shaft gives power even with a slow swing and forgives; a stiff shaft rewards a fast swing with precision but the sweet spot shrinks.
Üreticinin gövdeye yazdığı aralık. Gevşe: The range printed on the frame. Low tension gives trampoline and a bigger sweet spot, high tension gives feel and control.
Sapı yarım ölçü kalınlaştırır: kontrol +: Thickens the handle by half a size: control +6 · drive −5
Sap ölçüsü bir beceri ayarıdır, seviye i: Grip size is a skill setting and needs no level. An overgrip adds thickness on top.
Sap çevresi; sayı büyüdükçe incelir. Kal: Handle circumference; the higher the number, the thinner. A thick handle (G4) gives a firm hold and control, a thin one (G6) finger and wrist play and fast drives.
Esnek şaft affeder: zamanlama kaçsa da t: A flexible shaft forgives: the shuttle still goes where you aim when timing slips (wide sweet spot, less spray), but it holds the shuttle a moment and smashes come slower. A stiff shaft passes a fast arm's power straight through; it demands timing and the sweet spot narrows.
